feature: Ready-to-use customer inventory and bundled car photos
behavior: Adds a persistent, clearly labeled system sample fleet at startup without an owner import
Customer cards display large local images, varied brands, prices and working quote buttons
Legacy Toyota Vios / VF models / G63 names resolve images; unknown models have a bundled fallback
Existing inventory, user ownership and masked profiles are retained
build: All four Maven modules verified; final CarManage changes reverified and packaged
syntax: All modified JavaScript, JSON, YAML and Maven XML valid

postgresAndUi.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.7 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 7.5.0-3ubuntu1~18.04) 7.5.0, 64-bit

firstStart.method: jsdom DOM interactions with real Auth, Rental and two CarManage processes; Simple Discovery; no visual browser layout claim
checks: Customer opens a ready-to-use 20-model / 5-brand inventory with full photo elements, without owner import
First five cards show different brands
Every displayed photo returns HTTP 200 with image content and nonempty bytes
Brand/search filters work and a missing photo switches to the bundled fallback
Choosing a photo card calculates the correct three-day quote through real Rental -> CarManage HTTP calls
Legacy Toyota Vios and G63 records resolve real bundled model photos; owners still manage only their cars
Admin can edit a seeded rate before restart without changing its identity
Rental load balancing reaches both CarManage replicas sharing the PostgreSQL inventory

afterRestart.method: jsdom DOM interactions with real Auth, Rental and two CarManage processes; Simple Discovery; no visual browser layout claim
checks: Customer opens a ready-to-use 20-model / 5-brand inventory with full photo elements, without owner import
First five cards show different brands
Every displayed photo returns HTTP 200 with image content and nonempty bytes
PostgreSQL + both CarManage restarts preserve 20 samples, the edited sample rate and both owner cars
Choosing a photo card calculates the correct three-day quote through real Rental -> CarManage HTTP calls
Customer profile persists after a PostgreSQL restart

limits: DOM flows use jsdom, not a visual browser-layout test.
PostgreSQL 17.7 and four application processes were exercised directly with Simple Discovery; Docker/Eureka deployment was not executed for this change.
Images illustrate model families; sample plates, daily rates and availability do not represent verified rental inventory.
